name: Springs Preserve Volunteer Program (ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Greet guests. Help in the Botanical Garden. Talk with visitors at animal exhibits and the Butterfly Habitat. Or join one day group projects.
who_can_apply: Anyone 14 or older. Ages 14 to 17 must turn in a parental permission agreement.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Can count for community service hours.
duration: Not stated. They want long-term volunteers; group projects can be one day or an afternoon.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form with the Apply Now link on the page. Ages 14 to 17 also send in the parent permission form.
notes: Page does not mention training or required hours.
